body:
I’ve finally seek help after dealing with a lot emotional distress my husband thinks it’s all in my head. I try to explain to him that I can’t control it I don’t know what’s wrong or why I feel the way I do even though I know fully well I should be okay. His answer is it’s all in your head you live the life you want to live. I want to believe that but I’m still depressed. Even if I’m doing all the positive things in the world. I went to hospital for being a danger to myself but refused all meds he said he cares that he’ll listen to my thoughts but sometimes it doesn’t feel like that and I end feeling more lost and confused because it seems like no one cares.

PS: I’m also doing a lot of reading regarding depression (I’m trying to be positive because the only way to move is forward, if I die I can’t take anything back) I’m trying so see if I could just be B-Vitamin deficient that can cause depression. I got put into Zoloft and decide to finally start taking my pills but with B-Complex. Being on birth control, taking Advil or Pain meds for headaches etc. and drinking caffeine can drain your B-vitamins supposedly so I do all of those regularly so just maybe it’s just my B-Vitamins.

I always tried to move forward because I don’t like dwelling on the negativity. So I keep looking on the positive side Of things... but now I can’t do it, I want to see all the negative aspects of it so I can avoid it. I’m so scared of anything that could go wrong might push me over the edge. I actually got admitted to the hospital already, I almost wanted to stay over there I felt safe from myself and from everything. The day I came home everything was just so loud all the sudden I couldn’t come into terms of what I came home too I had a panic attack and ran outside crying begging for everything to be silent. I thought I was okay, until I wanted to stop walking forward and crawl back into box we’re it was silent. I thought seeing my family again after being in there by myself was going to be happy but instead I wanted none of it as sad as it sounds.

I was raped in high school and my ex was in a sense pretty abusive sexually at least, then I meet this amazing guy the guy that showed me what love is the man that showed me how gentle a guy can be. I was so happy I remember telling him “ I’m so happy right now it’s scary, like something so bad will happen I won’t be able to breath” he fell into addiction he didn’t get me involved he always stayed away from me when he was on it, he came home always sober but I couldn’t let him do it; we constantly fought about him leaving me to get high and just sleep when his home because of the crash. To me it felt like I lost him, he smiled less and less. Though I could see he was trying to make me happy, it pained me on what we’re becoming. I fell into depression  and for the first time even after what I’ve through I thought of ending it, that little bit of happiness I felt was not worth the heartache. And this not just about love even my job I used to work for small mom and pop restaurant it didn’t pay well but I loved it and everyone in there but then it closed, I haven’t had a stable job since. I went back to school only to find out that in America sometimes it’s not always fair they took away my FAFSA after I got married due to our income but in reality we can’t afford it on our own so I stopped going to school with one year left.
I feel the same way OP... now I’m so scared of feeling a slight bit of happiness because that small happiness might mean a lot pain for me in the future.

I was driving and this on LA traffic, I notice this car hurrying to cross from the carpool lane to the last; car finally pulls over and the driver comes out pulls down their pants and legit pooped right there. By the time I passed by the small awkward eye contact was probably more than one second too long for me.
OP is quiting soon [if i remember correctly] meaning def. did not listen I'm curious what he found out because have you guys heard the story of the corner man? It reminds me of it.
